quest.title: Ripe For Trouble
quest.description: Time to look for Tisoc, the missing guard...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x10000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Hey there, you two! Now, I can see the hot blood running in your veins as you rush into yonder cave, but stop there for a minute.

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Your attire tells me you're not from our tribe, the Scions of the Canopy... Heh, who am I kidding? You aren't from Natlan at all, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's up with that? Are only people from Natlan allowed in?

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: That goes without saying! But even then, not just anyone from our tribe can go in, let alone people from Natlan as a whole...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, you're pretty quick on the uptake for a flying kid with shaggy hair.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, of course, Paimon's a bright spark... Wait, are you saying she doesn't look like it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's certainly how you strike me, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's just... exactly that! You get me, don'cha, my outlander friend?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are you two talking about? Are you... complimenting Paimon? Hmm, doesn't quite seem like it...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: You can consider it praise, of course! Anyway... Name's Tisoc, and I'm the guard here — and an excellent one, at that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, Paimon's Paimon — as good a guide as you are a guard — and this is {NICKNAME}...

choices.text: Most excellent of adventurers, at your service!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: I see. An adventurer, huh? Makes sense. Doubt any ordinary traveler could find this spot anyway.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Ah! But anyway, I can't let you in. It is, after all, where our tribe produces our Flamegranates — real important business.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what's so special about that? You find those everywhere here in Natlan!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Ah, see that's where you'd be mistaken. If you pick them using a special technique, not only will they not explode, but they'll produce honey as rich in phlogiston as Quenepa Berries!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Dry the skins, and you can even get bags that our Couriers can carry. *sigh* Though you outlanders wouldn't get the beauty of something like this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so that's what those round sacks are made from...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: That's right. What's more, this cave is home to awesome Mountain King Flamegranates... Which makes me, the one who guards them, just as awesome.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: That said, the Mountain King Flamegranates have recently been... Eh, forget it. Whatever the case, unless you've got one of those green passes that rustle when you rub 'em, I'm not letting you through.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can't we even sneak a peek?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Not even that — not even people from our tribe are allowed in without a pass...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: And speaking of that, I heard <color=#00E1FFFF>someone lost theirs</color> a few days back. Couldn't find it either... Man, did Wayna chew them out.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Oops. Seems I've said more than I should.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Anyway, no entry without a pass, y'hear?

choices.text: Formidable Guard Slayer, at your service!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Really? Are you a "Formidable Guard" Slayer, or a Formidable "Guard Slayer," in that case?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Either way... *sigh* Does that mean I'm facing some sort of dangerous person right now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Nah, {M#he's}{F#she's} just talking nonsense! And even if {M#he}{F#she} were to slay any guards, they'd be "Ruin Guards"!

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: *sigh* Whatever will we do about the Mountain King Flamegranates— Wait, hey! Stop! I told you before — no passage without a pass...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: I mean, take <color=#00E1FFFF>the fella in our tribe</color> who lost his pass for example. I've known him a long time, but I can't let him pass either... Rules are rules. That's all there is to it.
Oh, this is bad. This is bad... Tisoc... Has something happened to him?
Should I go in and take a look? Ugh, but if that guy catches me, I'm going to get another earful... *sigh*

response.text: I—I—I'm Poca, a Courier here in the tribe. I—I'll have you know I even earned the title of Best Courier the year before last... It's the truth, you can check for yourself!

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: ...Wait a minute. I'm supposed to be the one asking these questions. I mean, I'm a Scion of the Canopy, aren't I!? So, who are you then? You're not even from Natlan, are you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, doesn't matter who you are or where you're from — the skittish types always look more suspicious...

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: Yeah, so I've been told... "Chin up and chest out, Poca!" But if you ask me, back-bent and careful-on-your-feet works better for my line of work.

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: A—Anyway, who are you two...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You introduce yourselves to Poca...

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: Ah, I see. So you're travelers from afar...

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: *sigh* I'm likely not supposed to tell you this, but this cave is the site of the Mother Flamegranate Tree's roots, which our tribe's always guarded.

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: Special "Mountain King Flamegranates" also grow there, making this a very, very important spot.

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: That's why my friend, the serious Tisoc, guards this spot. And while it's not good to speak ill of people behind their backs, I reckon he's almost too serious!

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: He bars the way here every day, and gets super mad if anyone tries to sneak past... That hasn't made him the most popular fella in our tribe.

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: Heh, not that I dislike him for it... But either way, he's not here today, and I've been waiting a while... A worrying sign.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't you go in and have a look yourself?

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: No, I couldn't! You need a pass to get in — you know those green-edged slips of paper? Those are the ones! And I don't have one...

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: They aren't easy to get your hands on, and strictly controlled too. I heard that someone lost one a couple of days ago, and Wayna gave them a real earful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(Hmm, that's weird. She seems to be describing that item we found... Why don't we show it to her, {NICKNAME}?)

choices.text: Might this be the pass you're talking about...

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: Ah, that is indeed the pass. Hmm... Ugh, you've put me in a tough spot now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tough spot... Why? We can just give it to you, and then, boom — not only do you have a pass, but you can even go in and check on your friend...

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: *sigh* S'not that simple. Having one won't stop Tisoc from lecturing me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And why's that?

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: Well, just think, little Paimon! These passes are usually given to those who can do long-term guard duty, but I'm just a tribe Courier...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Who runs to and fro every day...

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: Exactly. So if I went in, I'd be exposed right away. In theory, anyone who sees something that belongs to the tribe should have it retrieved... But I can't use it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, so that's it. In that case, we'd have just snuck in without showing you the pass at all!

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: Well, that's what makes things tough on me... How about this? I'm just going to pretend you're not here, like a Yumkasaurus with its eyes closed...

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: And could I trouble you to go in and have a look in my stead? Tisoc's serious, but he's not the brightest. Just say you got a pass from our chief. What do you say?

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: Of course, I'll be sure to reward you. In fact, I'd be glad to help someone who helped me and even retrieved one of our passes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh, y'know, {NICKNAME}... If Tisoc's not hurt, we'll get paid just for having a walk down there. Nifty, huh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, we'll go in and have a look.

response.speaker: Poca
response.text: In that case, I'll be up here under the Mother Flamegranate Tree, waiting for you, alright?

talks.objective: Enter the cavern and look for Tisoc, who has gone missing

dialogues.speaker: Poca
dialogues.text: Why, that Tisoc, worrying me like this... But anyway, I'm quite curious as to what he's been hiding lately...

talks.objective: Check on the person who has collapsed

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey! Wake up! You okay?

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Ugh... I... H—Have I been called to the Night Kingdom already? I believe I see a floating person...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait. Let me have a closer look at you... You're Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! It's Paimon, most excellent Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: *sigh* Thank you both so much. I was coming down here to check on things, but I wound up fainting... Perhaps the abnormal environment here has caused a drastic change in temperature...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: N—No, wait. First off, how did you get in here without a pass?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, we've got one. C'mon, {NICKNAME}, show him. That'll teach him to let passes pass, but not people!

choices.text: This is what you're looking for, I believe...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Hmm... Yes, this is one of our passes.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: I didn't expect to see it in the hands of an outlander. That's quite novel... But rather strange all the same.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why? Is this the wrong pass?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Right pass, wrong people. In truth, the green patterns on the side of the pass have names hidden in them... and this should be the one that was lost a few days ago.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: ...Let me guess. You found the pass and came here. In which case, the most sensible thing to have done in my absence would have been to send this back to our tribe.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: But you chose to come down here instead... Did someone instruct you to, then? And since they knew about the passes, but not all the details... A Courier, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What the... You do know your stuff after all! And Poca told us you were some overly serious, stubborn, thick-headed... Err, oops.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Oh, her, was it? Good. Then I know who to settle the score with once I get back up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ack, slip of the tongue... But still, she only asked us to come down here because she was concerned about you!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Oh really? I'd say she did it on purpose... *sigh* Didn't think she'd figure me out despite my efforts to hide it...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Still, she did send me an outlander unrelated to tribal affairs, like delivering a pillow to someone about to doze off.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Well then, brave warriors! Could you hear me out? I've a request I can't tell the rest of the tribe about. I'd preferred to have solved this myself...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: But as you can see, I ended up lying on the ground here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you're just a guard. Why do you have to investigate this cave too?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Actually... *sigh* It's the Mountain King Flamegranates. Here's one of them right here — the best of the best, both in terms of size and phlogiston content.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: It's just that they were supposed to ripen over the last two days... and yet, as you can see, they're still all green and blue. No signs of maturing at all.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: As their names suggest, they are to be offered to the Mountain King, and their importance needs no words to explain.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Also, this isn't just about the Mountain King Flamegranates... Most of the fruit grown on the Mother Tree amidst the cliffs are also "green" as can be.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: I've taken care of them for so many years. How could I not tell that something had gone wrong with the roots?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You could've just told the others in your tribe!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Pah. No one knows Flamegranate Trees better than I do, that much I can guarantee. In other words, if I can't solve the issue...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: ...Forget it. If I really can't solve this, I'll simply admit defeat and have people from either the Masters of the Night-Wind or the Collective of Plenty take a look. But before that, I'd like to give this a shot.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: It will, however, be difficult to pull off on my own, so... Well, you are brave outlander warriors, are you not...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we could help you, it's just that...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: ...Hah. I'll bet Poca sent you down here with promises of payment or something, yes?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Well, if we solve our Flamegranate Tree problem, I'll have her contribute a greater share.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Hey now, she's a Courier. More capable by far of paying than someone on a fixed salary like me!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: And anyway, she's the one who persuaded two outlanders to enter our taboo grounds, just so she could find out what's going on — there's gotta be a "cost" to that, right?

talks.objective: Explore the roots of the Flamegranate Tree

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, this is amazing! Such thick roots — and they're not burning despite being so close to the lava!

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Of course. The roots of the Flamegranate Tree not only endure proximity to Liquid Phlogiston — their fibers can even absorb it and grow as a result.

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: ...As such, being "close to lava" isn't the normal state. The roots should really be "immersed in lava."

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Seems like the issue's with the lava's surface... The entire root system's temperature has gone down. That's how lava that should never have cooled or piled up now blocks our way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So we just need to get the <color=#00E1FFFF>lava level to rise</color>, right?

choices.text: Well, if you could grow to prodigious size and sit in the lava, Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way! That sounds super hot!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You're talking nonsense again, aren't you, {NICKNAME}... Still, if we must make the lava rise...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Look, over there. The issue's just that the lava outlet's been blocked.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, Paimon gets it. All we need to do is blast that lava rock away, and the lava behind will... Wait, won't we be swallowed up by the surging tide once that happens?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Hmm... That's a good point, Paimon. Let's see if we can find another way...

choices.text: Quick, Paimon, vomit the food you ate into the pool of...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That won't raise the lava one bit! It'll swallow all that food — and at that point, it might as well stay in Paimon's stomach.

talks.objective: Explore the roots of the Flamegranate Tree

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Ach, as expected, this spot is completely blocked off... That said, I found what's causing the temperature change a moment ago.

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: And as I thought, it's because there's this... solidified lava blocking the airflow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So what do we do, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bold of you to think it's capable of bargaining at all! Why don't we find some other way to get it to "clear out"!?

choices.text: We could just blow it up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That could work — there's certainly more than enough fruit around here to cause a great big boom.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, Tisoc! Wake up! Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Ugh... I... H—Have I been called to the Night Kingdom already? I believe I see a floating person...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait, no, these are the roots of the Flamegranate Tree... Bah, and here I thought I'd gone to the Night Kingdom already.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, you might certainly have ended up in a faraway place, had we not come down to have a look...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you so much. I wanted to come down and check things out, but the temperature changed drastically for some reason... and I collapsed.

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: N—No, wait, hang on. First off, how did you get in here without a pass?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, we've got one. C'mon, {NICKNAME}, show him. That'll teach him to let passes pass, but not people!

choices.text: This is what you're looking for, I believe...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Hmm... Yes, this is one of our passes.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Sorry, could I get your names...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You introduce yourselves to Tisoc...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon, huh. I see...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: I didn't expect to see it in the hands of an outlander. That's quite novel... But rather strange all the same.

talks.objective: Go to the lower levels of the Flamegranate's roots
Go to the lower levels of the Flamegranate's roots
Go to the lower levels of the Flamegranate's roots
Find a way to increase the Liquid Phlogiston levels

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh, the lava's rising! The roots of the Flamegranate Tree are glowing where they meet with the lava...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Ah, now this should be the normal look of things... Flamegranate Trees truly are mysterious.

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: When I followed my father around as a little lad, it was witnessing this scene that convinced me that I must take care of the trees as he did...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will this allow the Flamegranates to mature?

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: That's right. Not only that, but with your help, these ones have been stocked full of absorbed phlogiston. They'll make for the best Flamegranates ever... Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that an earthquake!? N—No, wait, the lava's rising! C'mon, run! To the high ground!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—That was way too scary! What in the world happened back there? That lava just came bubbling out from underground like sludge...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: *pants* Let me catch my breath for a bit... I think blowing the rocks up might have been too much agitation for the lava.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, you sure it won't be a problem that it surged up so high? Y'know, when a withered flower sucks in too much water...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Well, that's a... good point, but at the same time, the Liquid Phlogiston levels will drop slowly until it becomes stable, just as before.

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: That said, thanks to that... Look, you two! Look at the Mountain King Flamegranates' color...

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Let's take a closer look, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Tisoc
dialogues.text: Wow, such perfect coloration.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Ah, just the sight of it's enough to make you feel warm... Perhaps we'll be able to pick them after a few more days of observation.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: The Mountain King's not been in the best shape in recent years. If it eats this fruit, things might take a turn for the better...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Either way, I can't thank you enough. This... isn't much, but take it as a token of my gratitude.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, we'll take it gladly, then. Wait, didn't you say you'd have Poca fork out the lion's share?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Haha, I was kidding. What's hers is hers, and what's mine is mine. We're not so close that I could bill her for helping me out.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: But well, what did I say? I'm the Flamegranate expert, aren't I?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, guess you're an excellent expert, on top of being a great guard!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then. Let's head back up, and try not to faint this time!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: That won't happen so easily now since things have stabilized here... But anyway, the pass, please. It's an important item as far as our tribe's concerned, after all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, right. But what if we wanna swing by again?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: If you're just swinging by to have another look around—

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: I'm just going to have to keep one eye closed, just as a Yumkasaurus might.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—That was way too scary! What in the world happened back there? That lava just came bubbling out from underground like sludge...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Good thing Paimon clung onto you, {NICKNAME}, or you might've fallen right in!

choices.text: Maybe fly me to safety next time?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, don't get ahead of yourself. That'd be way too tiring!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: *pants* Let me catch my breath for a bit... I think blowing the rocks up might have been too much agitation for the lava.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, you sure it won't be a problem that it surged up so high? Y'know, when a withered flower sucks in too much water...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Well, that's a... good point, but at the same time, the Liquid Phlogiston levels will drop slowly until it becomes stable, just as before.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: That said, thanks to that... Look, you two! Look at the Mountain King Flamegranates' color...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Let's take a closer look, shall we?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Wow, such perfect coloration.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Ah, just the sight of it's enough to make you feel warm... Perhaps we'll be able to pick them after a few more days of observation.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: The Mountain King's not been in the best shape in recent years. If it eats this fruit, things might take a turn for the better...

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Either way, I can't thank you enough. This... isn't much, but take it as a token of my gratitude.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, we'll take it gladly, then. Wait, didn't you say you'd have Poca fork out the lion's share?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: Haha, I was kidding. What's hers is hers, and what's mine is mine. We're not so close that I could bill her for helping me out.

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: But well, what did I say? I'm the Flamegranate expert, aren't I?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, guess you're an excellent expert, on top of being a great guard!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then. Let's head back up, and try not to faint this time!

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: That won't happen so easily now since things have stabilized here... But anyway, the pass, please. It's an important item as far as our tribe's concerned, after all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, right. But what if we wanna swing by again?

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: If you're just swinging by to have another look around—

response.speaker: Tisoc
response.text: I'm just going to have to keep one eye closed, just as a Yumkasaurus might.

choices.text: Thought I'd lose my legs for a moment back there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: R—Right! C'mon, let Paimon have a look at you... Looks like they're in one piece. There, there, don't worry...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You escape from the surging Liquid Phlogiston with great difficulty and haste...
